meta.name: The Secret of the Shiledars
meta.description: A secret society unravels a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with Rajeev leading the quest to protect it from falling into wrong hands, ultimately becoming the chief of the Shiledars.

videos.title: The Beckoning
videos.overview: History enthusiast Dr. Ravi's strange encounter with Judge Dixit changes the course of his life. However, he also finds himself implicated in a crime.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Ravi embarks on a quest into the unknown with Aditya and Priyal. A well-kept secret, hidden for years, awaits him.

videos.title: The Lineage
videos.overview: Ravi decodes the clue and uncovers another. He discovers a new cryptic box while grappling with the pain of losing a friend. Will he continue to pursue this lineage further?

videos.title: The Code
videos.overview: The cryptic box sets Ravi on a new journey with historian Pratap Chandrarao. By now, Ravi, Aditya, and Priyal have become fugitives with the cops chasing them.

videos.title: The Treasure
videos.overview: Ravi and Pratap reach the hidden treasure but realise it is not the secret they are seeking. Where is the real treasure?

videos.title: Pride and Honour
videos.overview: The realisation dawns that only a true Shiledar can uncover the hidden treasure of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Is Ravi the true Shiledar?
